about: Mission breakdown of the owner's story (docs/story/THE_RISE_OF_THE_RAVEN_KING.md), chapter by chapter. status: built (playable; tested by script) | partial (something of it is playable; read the note) | fight_only (the champion fight is playable in its place, without the chapter round it) | planned. Minutes are design targets, not measured playtime: nothing here has been timed with a person playing.

acts.title: The Burning Snow
acts.theme: Everything can be taken in one night, and someone can still choose to give it back.

missions.title: The Last Warm Day
missions.summary: The woodpile and Raven-Feeder; Ragnar's lesson; the hunt, the fire, wooden swords; the grey-cloaked stranger at the door.
missions.note: Built as the first chapter's day. The stranger (Torvald), the runes in the ash and the axe's name in dialogue are not in yet.

missions.title: The Night They Came
missions.summary: Thirty torches on the ridge. Ragnar meets Håkon; Ylva gives Eirik the axe and cuts Kettil's hand; the old birch, the ridge, the thin ice.
missions.note: Built as the night raid and escape. Håkon by name, Kettil's hand, Sigurd counting silver and the lie "he is under the river" are not shown yet.

missions.title: The Hollow Under the Spruce
missions.summary: Shelter, three days to make fire, what there is to eat.
missions.note: Built as "The Long White".

missions.title: The She-Wolf
missions.summary: A starving wolf with a snare on her leg. Kill her for the meat, or cut the wire.
missions.note: Built as feed-or-kill; the snare and cutting the wire are not in yet.

missions.title: Are You a Troll?
missions.summary: Bjorn finds him at the thaw and carries him home; Signe, Freydis, forty days of silence.
missions.note: Built as the fever and the farm. Bjornstead is still one farm in a dale, not the coastal village of twenty houses.

missions.title: Under the Hearthstone
missions.summary: He buries Raven-Feeder beside the hearth.

missions.title: The Fallen Nest
missions.summary: One black chick, one white. Feeding them; naming them.

missions.title: Old Hrefna's Bones
missions.summary: The seeress and the five sayings.
missions.note: Old Hrefna is not in the game yet. The five omens round Bjornstead are.

missions.title: The Old Birch
missions.summary: The storm off the sea, the climb, the strike; three days of fever; the scar and the first word: Warm. Boy. Wake.
missions.note: New in 0.13.

missions.title: What the Sky Left
missions.summary: Raven's Voice and Raven's Eye: the lost lamb found from the air.

missions.title: The Stick and the Little Shield
missions.summary: Bjorn's feint from behind; Stormguard answers for the first time; Hrefna names it.
missions.note: Stormguard exists for the grown Eirik; this scene does not.

missions.title: Seven Seats
missions.summary: Svartøy: the seven champions, the two hands, Kettil in the lowest seat. Ten winters pass.

acts.title: The Farmer's Axe
acts.theme: A peaceful life is worth defending.

missions.title: Strength and Where to Put It
missions.summary: Splitting wood with Bjorn; Old Skeggi eats the boot; Freydis.
missions.note: Splitting wood with Bjorn, Old Skeggi and the boot (he ends on the longhouse roof), Freydis.

missions.title: The Wounded Elk
missions.summary: Mjöll's pictures: water, blood, broken branch.
missions.note: Raven's Eye marks water, blood and the broken branch; the elk lies at the stream.

missions.title: The Red Cow
missions.summary: Hauk against Grjotgard at the Thing.
missions.note: Both men are heard; Bjorn gives the story's judgment. There is no choice to make: the story makes it.

missions.title: The Harvest Feast
missions.summary: Kaestur, the wrestling match, the ache in the scar.
missions.note: Kaestur (a timed straight face), the wrestling match (he lets Bjorn throw him), the birch at night.

missions.title: Wolves
missions.summary: Seven riders. Kettil Red-Hand demands tribute and two girls; he knows the scar.
missions.note: Raven's Eye on the river road; Kettil on the black horse; the story's words in the yard.

missions.title: The Stone by the Hearth
missions.summary: He lifts the flat stone.
missions.note: The flat stone, the memory, Bjorn's spare shield, 'The boy who survived.'

missions.title: The Fight for Bjornstead
missions.summary: Waves through the yard; the barn door, the pigsty, the narrow lane; Sót and the helmet strap.
missions.note: Four waves (25 men) and Kettil's escort of four: the barn door, the pigsty mud, the lane, Sót and the helmet strap, Freydis and the bucket. Balance is untested by hand.

missions.title: The Boy Who Survived
missions.summary: Kettil: the buckler, the mud, Stormguard; the children in the barn; the wolf brooch in the mud.
missions.note: The buckler, the mud, Stormguard, the shield rim; he turns his back for the six children; the brooch; Freydis at the well. No spare-or-kill choice.

missions.title: Did You See Him Die?
missions.summary: Håkon cuts the wolf from Kettil's cloak; the bounty.
missions.note: Played in the Hall of Wolves on Svartøy with the story's lines. Figures are stand-ins; the hall has no roof.

missions.title: Grim and Grimolf
missions.summary: Mjöll at their camp; the net across the path; Skull-Ringer; outlawry.
missions.note: The camp watched from the air, the net strung, Skull-Ringer at midnight, the Thing, the leaky boat, Bjorn by the fire.

missions.title: The First Speech
missions.summary: The vote at the Thing stones.
missions.note: Three views heard, then the story's speech. The vote is told, not played.

missions.title: The Hardest Summer
missions.summary: Timber, ditch, palisade, the watchtower by the old birch; the latrine trench.
missions.note: Felling, hauling with the horse, the ditch, the latrine trench, the palisade, the watchtower, Bjorn's shield wall: each a short timed task. The ditch is drawn on the ground, not dug; the palisade has no fighting walk.

missions.title: Kaupang
missions.summary: The market, the thrall pen, Leif and Orm the reeve.
missions.note: Kaupang on the map: quay, market, thrall pen, tavern. The list is bought; Leif and Orm; the drunk sailor.

missions.title: The Wreck in the Sea Cave
missions.summary: The tide, the silver, Gisli under the beam.
missions.note: A dive with breath and depth: silver from the wreck, then Gisli under the beam and the basket let go. Swimming exists only here.

missions.title: Weighted Dice
missions.summary: The Kaupang Thing; Leif pays his debts; the Sea-Raven.
missions.note: Three pieces of evidence put to the Thing in the right order; the Sea-Raven comes home to Bjornstead's pier.

missions.title: The Arm-Ring
missions.summary: The feast; Bjorn's ring; smoke in the west.
missions.note: Leif's story with Gisli correcting it, the goat's trial, the arm-ring, the smoke in the west.

acts.title: The Wolves of Iron
acts.theme: Courage means protecting people who cannot repay you.

missions.title: Iron for Wool
missions.summary: Jarnøy; Arvid kills the collector; Håkon's demand.
missions.note: The trade, the collectors at the pier, Arvid's three strokes, the three who are let go, Hroald, and the demand nine days later. The voyage is a card.

missions.title: The Vote
missions.summary: Bjorn: he eats one village at a time.
missions.note: The Thing in the story's words: Hauk, Bjorn's speech, Ari sent home. There is no vote to cast: the story casts it.

missions.title: Brokk
missions.summary: The mule, the anvil, the hand.
missions.note: Brokk at the forge with his mule; the axe and its collar; a different tale of his hand each time he is asked.

missions.title: Astrid
missions.summary: The ravine camp; nine farmers; no brother.
missions.note: Found through the raven's eye; the arrow at his throat; the trail to the ravine; two guards marked for Astrid's bow; five raiders; six farmers freed where the story has nine.

missions.title: Torvald
missions.summary: The grey cloak and the hammer.
missions.note: Torvald at the gate with his horse; his shield-wall drill; the question about a ring, a brooch, a letter.

missions.title: The Well, Not the Harbour
missions.summary: Ingrid's hospital; Leif fetches water.
missions.note: Ingrid's hospital is laid out before the hall doors, not inside. Leif and the water are played as the scene.

missions.title: Six Days
missions.summary: The trench, the stakes, the Stinking Ditch.
missions.note: Two lengths of trench and the ditch: timed tasks. Brokk's furnaces and Astrid's archers in the forest are told, not played.

missions.title: Eleven Ships
missions.summary: Arrows from the headland; the charge; the shield wall.
missions.note: Three volleys under the shield, five archers marked from the air, the charge into the Stinking Ditch, then the wall: sixteen defenders hold attackers in pairs while those who break through come for Eirik. A stand-in for 150 against 200. The bridge that collapses is not built.

missions.title: The Side Gate
missions.summary: Hold the wall, or go back for the families. Grjotgard.
missions.note: The story makes the choice: he takes the ten to the side gate, holds it, and empties three houses. Grjotgard and Hauk, in the story's words.

missions.title: Through the Granary
missions.summary: Up the fallen beam to the tower top; Arne Longshot.
missions.note: The raven finds the way up; the fire is a timed task and the climb a fade; the point-blank arrow and the Stormguard; Arne with seax and knives; the fall into the granary.

missions.title: Choose
missions.summary: Ulf Two-Blades; the burning boats.
missions.note: Ulf cannot be beaten here and Eirik cannot die: the fight ends when the Stormguard has answered twice, or on a clock. Three boats against a timer (Leif takes one), the salute, the pyres, Hroald's words to Arvid.

missions.title: Work, Not Gold
missions.summary: Weregild; twelve carts of iron; the first reforging; Storm-Yew; Ingrid joins.
missions.note: The gold refused, Ingrid's leave, the second forge, the first reforging played at the anvil, a mail shirt, Storm-Yew on the birch hill, rotten bait. Weregild and the twelve carts are told.

missions.title: Destroy the Roots
missions.summary: Håkon will not send the fleet.
missions.note: Played in the Hall of Wolves with the story's lines, then the straw man on Svartøy's harbour.

acts.title: Blood Across the Sea
acts.theme: Trust is a leader's greatest strength, and his greatest weakness.

missions.title: Fafnir's Bed
missions.summary: The treasure ship; life aboard; Ingrid and the dice.
missions.note: Two quiet years at Ravenhold (the market, the healing house, Torvald's drill), the ship from Solvik, Ari, then the days aboard: the sunstone, Gisli's belt, Ingrid's seawater, Leif's dice. The decks stand still in open water: the ships do not sail.

missions.title: Three Sails in the Fog
missions.summary: Rurik's ships surround the knarr.
missions.note: The white raven finds three longships in the fog; Rurik's offer; then boarders over the Sea-Raven's rail, with six men of Ravenhold holding their own. Astrid at the masthead, Leif snapping oars, the buckets and Torvald on the knarr are seen and told, not played.

missions.title: The Honorable One
missions.summary: Rurik Shieldsplitter on the deck of the Sea-Raven.
missions.note: On the deck of the Sea-Raven, in the story's words. He knows the axe partway through; when Eirik slips on the wet oar he waits. It can be lost and tried again. His men's surrender is told.

missions.title: Wessex
missions.summary: The burh, Wulfstan, the token; the fever; the harbour wall.
missions.note: A small port inside an earth bank, a stone church with a bell, monks who run, Wulfstan, the token and the letter. The girl lies on a pallet by the farm door because buildings cannot be entered; the herbs are three stops while Leif haggles; the harbor wall is a scene.

missions.title: The Sealed Chest
missions.summary: The letters; the bloodline; Torvald at the cooking fire.
missions.note: The chest on the deck; the letters as the story tells them; the night scene from above the ship.

missions.title: Smoke, Everywhere
missions.summary: Kinn, Fedje, Skorpa, Gulen, Solvik: survivors, raiders, the signal tower, the boy in the sea cave.
missions.note: Kinn (three pulled from the water), Fedje (a trail and five looters, with Astrid), the refugees at Ravenhold's pier, Skorpa (the signal tower held with four defenders), Gulen (three wounded carried on Bjorn's grey horse), Solvik (the dig, the boy in the sea cave), Leif on the floor. Kinn, Fedje, Skorpa and Gulen are still the small sandbox islands, so each is a short scene.

missions.title: An Attack on One
missions.summary: Six kings in Bjorn's longhouse; the token.
missions.note: Before the doors of Bjorn's longhouse, not inside. Each king says where he stands in the story's sentence; Eirik's speech; the token. There is no choice to make: the story makes it.

missions.title: The Third Fire
missions.summary: The trap; Ari; Astrid's shoulder.
missions.note: The letter and the ribbon; the fire read through the raven's eyes; then the trap from the Sea-Raven's deck: two burning ropes, three rocks marked from the air, three hauled from the water, boarders, Ari. The convoy is half a dozen boats, the deck does not move, and the ramming is a shake and a fade.

missions.title: How Many Called You Brother
missions.summary: The axe a finger from Ingrid's face.
missions.note: The story's words. One key swings and one lowers the axe: there is no choice, because the story has none.

missions.title: Not Yet
missions.summary: Kettil's raid on Ravenhold; Bjorn's leg; the birch with two crowns.
missions.note: Kettil's raid is told at the gate by what it left: the harbor, three warehouses, Bjorn's leg. Hauk on the pier; the birch with two new crowns.

acts.title: The Broken Raven
acts.theme: Building something is harder than destroying it.

missions.title: I'll Carry It
missions.summary: Hauk; choosing who is disappointed.
missions.note: The assembly at the Thing stones (Hauk, then Eirik's answer), then a tower, the harbor and a ship on the slip, each a timed task with the story's cost told after it. The story lists the three costs without a choice, so Eirik does all three; there is nothing to weigh.

missions.title: Boiled Clean
missions.summary: The flux; the blot; Hrefna and Ingrid.
missions.note: The snowed-in town: the grain count, Ingrid's rules, a latrine dug away from the well, straw burned, the quarrel with Hrefna, the blot at dusk. The quarrel and the blot are scenes; the sacrifice is not shown. Leif's 'emergency frog' is here too.

missions.title: Big! Big! Big!
missions.summary: The whale; whale law.
missions.note: Found through the white raven's eyes on the west shore; three timed cuts with the whole town round her; Hallvard recites the whale law. The whale is one large shape with an opened flank.

missions.title: The First Law
missions.summary: No one who comes for shelter is made a thrall for debt.
missions.note: The creditor, the debtor and his daughter before the hall; Eirik pays, and the vote is told. A scene with one conversation.

missions.title: The Tannery Yard
missions.summary: Ottar's camp; Sót's eyes; the pits; eleven prisoners; the cage.
missions.note: The arrow in the gate; Astrid; Sót's eyes over the camp (a dark filter and three marks to find); in through the tannery yard; into the pits when the dogs come; the pen and the cage; a fight out through the yard with Leif and Astrid; dawn, the supply ships sailing, and the sea. The story's thirty guards are three who walk, three at the fire and five at the end. Stealth is light: one meter, and the pits. The eleven follow a set path. The ships cannot be burned, as the story has it.

missions.title: Inside the Collar
missions.summary: The oath-ring; Bjorn knew.
missions.note: Brokk at the forge with the collar open; the ring is carried from then on. 'Bjorn knew' is told in the same scene.

missions.title: Gannet Rock
missions.summary: Old Thrand tells him everything.
missions.note: A card for the voyage, then the turf hut near the top, the puffin, and Thrand's whole account sitting on the floor. Gannet Rock is still the small sandbox island.

missions.title: Sixty Berserkers
missions.summary: The forest settlement; Svanhild.
missions.note: Svanhild on the pier, Jarl Jorund at his hall, the march to the third village, and a fight among log houses with ten of Ravenhold, Leif and Astrid's arrows; Svanhild arrives part-way. A dozen berserkers stand for sixty and three guards for her thirty. Vængr is still the small sandbox island, so the march is short.

missions.title: The Holmgang Ground
missions.summary: Skarde Bear-Maw; the lie; wait.
missions.note: A real fight on the hazel square. At four-fifths of his health Skarde says the lie; Eirik loses his temper, is thrown in the mud, gets up and waits (about half a minute, not played). Then it can be finished, or lost and retried. Jorund's oath and the voyage home with Svanhild follow.

chapters.title: The Letter That Was Never Written

missions.title: The Ribbon
missions.summary: The forgery; Torvald's whole confession.
missions.note: Astrid's prisoner in the hills, then the cell and Torvald's whole confession in the story's words, and Signe at night. The cell is a log cage beside the wall, because buildings cannot be entered. The judgment is left for Act VI, as in the story.

missions.title: One Night
missions.summary: The archery contest; the thrown sword; the harbour wall; the boat from Myrholm.
missions.note: Brokk's sea serpent; the contest at the butts and the kiss at the harbor wall are cutscenes, not played; near midnight, the boat from Myrholm. Ends the act.

acts.title: The Nine Oaths
acts.theme: A kingdom is built from promises, sacrifice and the courage to trust again.

missions.title: The Arrow With the Blue Thread
missions.summary: Gest; Astrid arrested; Mjöll over the marsh; surety.
missions.note: Arrive by the causeway; Thora's refusal; Gest in the channel and the arrest at the cage; three things found from the air (a trail, a hidden boat, a camp); the surety. Finding them is flying over a mark and pressing a key. The council is seven townspeople standing; the feud is told.

missions.title: The Hunt
missions.summary: Eyvind's channels; the bog body.
missions.note: Eyvind on the causeway; the hunt is cut to three places by fades (the story's 'slow and miserable'); burning leeches off is a short timed task; the man the bog kept. Nobody wades waist-deep: the marsh is shallows and dry ground.

missions.title: Under the Rotting Tower
missions.summary: Eydis the Mire; Sót.
missions.note: The approach is three small steps (Astrid's tripwire, Eyvind's solid ground, two archers marked from the air), then a real fight in knee-deep water with stake pits. She cannot be worn below about half her health until the black raven is sent at her; then the next blow breaks the spear and her guard. The proof in her camp and Thora's oath follow.

missions.title: Better Than Yours
missions.summary: Brokk and Halvar; the sky-iron; the true story of the hand.
missions.note: The meeting across the harbor, Halvar's workshop, Jarl Gudmund, Raven-Feeder's second reforging (watched, not worked), the night by the dying forge, Gudmund's answer. The three days are a fade.

missions.title: Lane by Lane
missions.summary: Eighty men with pitch; getting the smiths out.
missions.note: Three short fights with seven allies, falling back along the harbor street; four of Håkon's men to a lane stand for eighty. Astrid and Svanhild leading the smiths out is seen at the start, not played.

missions.title: The Doorway
missions.summary: Brokk holds it.
missions.note: A cutscene of about a minute and a half in the story's words: the two warriors, the hammer, 'Don't stop for me', the Stormguard that is useless. It can be skipped.

missions.title: The Quarry Edge
missions.summary: Bersi Black-Anvil; it will not guard anyone else.
missions.note: A real fight that starts at the forge and is carried to the quarry by a fade at a little under half his health. There he cannot be cut down: Eirik has to stand on the marked ledge and drop flat as the hammer comes up. The streets between are not fought through, and the ledge does not break.

missions.title: Nine Days
missions.summary: The boat on the beach; the last reforging; Star-Fall.
missions.note: The forge before dawn (Brokk's last words, in full), then the boat on the beach nine days later: Eirik speaks, and lights it. Halvar finishes the last reforging and Star-Fall. The dividing of the tools is told. Star-Fall is in Halvar's hand; Eirik does not carry it.

missions.title: On Halfdan's Ring
missions.summary: The oath; the pens.
missions.note: The alliance at the Thing stones; Torvald's confession; then the oath on Halfdan's ring. There is no choice to make, because the story makes it.

chapters.title: The Death of the Iron Circle

missions.title: Which End Cuts
missions.summary: Sigurd and Håkon.
missions.note: Sigurd's messenger at the gate, Eirik's one line, then a cutscene in the Hall of Wolves. Three stand-ins are the Circle's other envoys.

missions.title: Swear to Each Other
missions.summary: Nine hands on the ring, and Bjorn's on top.
missions.note: A field under a red-and-white sail-cloth roof; what each island brings is told; then a cutscene as nine rulers and Bjorn come to the ring. The 'three hundred listening at the edges' are about twenty.

missions.title: The Bride-Price
missions.summary: Leif against a king; the Twins; the medical kit.
missions.note: Leif goes into King Hroald's tent and comes out again (the hour is a line); the wedding and the harbor wall the next morning are cutscenes of about two minutes together. The bride's crown and the pendant are told, not modelled.

missions.title: The Last Night
missions.summary: Every companion; Bjorn, Signe, the stolen cloth.
missions.note: Svartøy from the sky is a fly-over cutscene of the real island; then three companions to talk to, the last night with Bjorn, Signe and Freydis, and the walk to the harbor before dawn. Choosing commanders and ships is told. Ends the act.

acts.title: The Raven King
acts.theme: Revenge ends a life. Leadership decides what happens afterward.

missions.title: The Floating Wall
missions.summary: Thirty ships chained; Leif round the end; the marsh boats.

missions.title: Husband and Wife
missions.summary: Leif, then Eirik, against Ulf across two burning decks.
missions.note: The fight is built on two lashed ships in Svartøy harbour.

missions.title: The Slopes
missions.summary: Four hundred ashore; twice he goes back for trapped men.
missions.note: Svartøy is on the map: harbour, road, ravine, bridge, upper town, hall, pens, cove.

missions.title: The Bend in the Road
missions.summary: Kettil: mud, the buckler, the boot knife.
missions.note: The fight is built at the bend.

missions.title: Star-Fall
missions.summary: Torvald's twenty; Arvid; Kári.
missions.note: The pens and the cove stand.

missions.title: Left-Left, Right-Right
missions.summary: The burning bridge.
missions.note: The fight is built on the bridge, with her rhythm and the fire.

missions.title: The Steps of the Hall
missions.summary: Make him swing; the rim; the neck.
missions.note: The fight is built at the gate.

missions.title: You Have Your Grandfather's Eyes
missions.summary: Why he did it.
missions.note: The hall stands, with the high seat and the broken ring.

missions.title: Four Parts
missions.summary: The sword of the guardsman; the weapons of war; Wolf's Judgment; the last oath.
missions.note: The fight is built in four parts, with the scar going cold in the last.

missions.title: The Killing Is
missions.summary: Three days on Svartøy.

missions.title: Stand Beside Me
missions.summary: The Thing at Gulen; the first laws.

acts.title: Epilogue: The Old Birch
acts.theme: Let our children inherit something better than our wars.

missions.title: Twelve Years Later
missions.summary: The stones; Torvald and Hauk; the Thing-Ring.

missions.title: He Lost Two
missions.summary: Liv; the Twins on the wall.

missions.title: Home
missions.summary: Little Brokk; the young raven with one white feather.

side_missions.title: Silver in the River
side_missions.premise: Catch trout for the pot.

side_missions.title: Whispers of the Ironwolf
side_missions.premise: Hrolf's rumour about the question Håkon asks.

side_missions.title: The Raven Stone
side_missions.premise: Read Halfdan's stone on the knoll.

side_missions.title: Thyra's Race
side_missions.premise: Foot-race to the well; she cheats.

side_missions.title: The Missing Ewe
side_missions.premise: Follow tracks to a wolf den; kill, drive off or let be.

side_missions.title: Brokk's Last Iron
side_missions.premise: Find bog iron for a smith who will not last the winter.

side_missions.title: The Drowned Bell
side_missions.premise: A church bell lost by raiders lies in the shallows.

side_missions.title: Two Brothers, One Boat
side_missions.premise: Judge an inheritance; both versions are half true.

side_missions.title: The Widow's Field
side_missions.premise: Bring in a harvest before the frost, alone or by rousing neighbours.

side_missions.title: Wolf-Head
side_missions.premise: An outlaw with a price turns out to be wrongly named.

side_missions.title: The White Stag
side_missions.premise: A stag the hunters say is sacred. Shoot it and the village remembers.

side_missions.title: Rune-Carver's Debt
side_missions.premise: Carry a memorial stone commission between feuding families.

side_missions.title: Dice at the Bent Oar
side_missions.premise: Win a ship's share at dice, or catch the weighted die.

side_missions.title: Arm of the North
side_missions.premise: An arm-wrestling ladder with a champion who throws matches.

side_missions.title: Mead and Memory
side_missions.premise: A drinking contest that ends in a rooftop chase.

side_missions.title: The Straight Shaft
side_missions.premise: Archery tournament with wind and moving marks.

side_missions.title: Bearded Luck
side_missions.premise: Axe-throwing for a silver arm-ring.

side_missions.title: The Honest Thief
side_missions.premise: Recover a stolen cargo without the reeve learning who took it.

side_missions.title: Amber Road
side_missions.premise: Run amber to Hedeby ahead of a rival trader.

side_missions.title: The Toll at Limfjord
side_missions.premise: Pay, sneak past or break a chieftain's toll chain.

side_missions.title: A Thrall's Name
side_missions.premise: A thrall claims to be a jarl's son. Buy him, free him or prove it.

side_missions.title: The Bog Offering
side_missions.premise: Weapons surface in a bog; someone is digging them up to sell.

side_missions.title: Saltmarsh Ghosts
side_missions.premise: Lights on the marsh are wreckers, not spirits.

side_missions.title: The Grove Keeper
side_missions.premise: Earn passage through a sacred grove by labour, not silver.

side_missions.title: Nine Nights
side_missions.premise: A man hangs himself in a tree for wisdom; his kin want him cut down.

side_missions.title: The Bear-Shirt
side_missions.premise: A berserker challenges every traveller on the lake ice.

side_missions.title: Iron Under the Lake
side_missions.premise: Dredge lake ore for the first pattern-welded blade.

side_missions.title: Sister's Loom
side_missions.premise: Freydis asks for dye plants from three regions.

side_missions.title: The Runaway Bride
side_missions.premise: A marriage alliance, and a bride who would rather sail.

side_missions.title: Minster Bread
side_missions.premise: Starving farmers ask you to take the monks' grain.

side_missions.title: The Scribe's Eye
side_missions.premise: A monk will write Eirik's saga, if told the truth.

side_missions.title: King's Peace
side_missions.premise: Carry terms between an English ealdorman and a Norse camp.

side_missions.title: The Roman Road
side_missions.premise: Follow a ruined road to a buried hoard.

side_missions.title: Fenland Hunt
side_missions.premise: Wild boar in reed beds where the bow is useless.

side_missions.title: The Hostage
side_missions.premise: Free a child hostage from a burh without bloodshed.

side_missions.title: Whale Road
side_missions.premise: A whale hunt from open boats.

side_missions.title: The Becalmed
side_missions.premise: Five days without wind and a crew that blames the foreigner.

side_missions.title: Storm-Wife
side_missions.premise: A woman on a skerry claims to call weather.

side_missions.title: The Skerry Hoard
